name: Cape of Wasps
summary: Summon a wasp swarm into your space for ranged concealment and retaliation against melee attackers, or make it carry you with a 20-foot fly speed.
description: A wasp swarm fills your space without attacking you. It grants partial concealment against ranged attacks, and a creature that successfully strikes you in melee takes 2d6 swarm damage and the swarm's poison. As a free action, you can make the swarm cling tightly and carry you at a 20-foot fly speed with poor maneuverability; in that form it neither grants concealment nor harms melee attackers. You can switch it back as a free action.
